# Recorded PubMed fixtures

Raw responses from NCBI E-utilities, recorded **2026-11-02** with `curl`
(`efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&rettype=abstract&retmode=xml`, `esearch.fcgi?...&retmode=json`). Nothing here was edited
or generated by the code under test. NCBI sends non-ASCII as numeric references (`&#x2013;`), so the files are
ASCII on disk and the parsed text contains real en dashes, non-breaking spaces and so on.

**Review status:** recorded by a coding agent at the team's request. By the fixture rule in `CLAUDE.md`, the
teammate who did not run the recording should skim the "why" column and spot-check two or three files against
pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov before relying on them. Tick here when done: [ ]

| File | PMID | Why it is here |
|---|---|---|
| `structured_rct_42897521.xml` | 42897521 | Structured abstract (5 labels incl. `CLINICAL TRIAL`), non-breaking space, 40 cited DOIs in its reference list (DOI-scoping trap) |
| `inline_italic_rct_42964126.xml` | 42964126 | `<i>` inside `<AbstractText>`, RCT |
| `inline_sup_unstructured_42848283.xml` | 42848283 | `<sup>` inside an unstructured abstract |
| `narrative_review_42737424.xml` | 42737424 | Narrative review with markup (large, many references) |
| `registry_protocol_42787272.xml` | 42787272 | ClinicalTrials.gov id in `DataBankList` (NCT06049186) |
| `retracted_rct_registry_41911553.xml` | 41911553 | `Retracted Publication` RCT with an abstract and NCT06128967 |
| `retracted_inline_39502250.xml` | 39502250 | Retracted, with `<b> <i> <sub> <sup>` in the abstract |
| `retracted_no_abstract_41911555.xml` | 41911555 | Retracted and no abstract (skipped before dedup sees it) |
| `letter_no_abstract_42722381.xml` | 42722381 | Letter, no abstract |
| `erratum_42930381.xml` | 42930381 | `Published Erratum` (dropped by dedup) |
| `retraction_notice_42964977.xml` | 42964977 | `Retraction Notice`, the type PubMed uses today (the plan calls it `Retraction of Publication`) |
| `medlinedate_7997269.xml` | 7997269 | `<MedlineDate>1994 Dec 22-29</MedlineDate>` instead of `<Year>` |
| `esearch_metformin_crc.json` | n/a | esearch for `metformin AND colorectal neoplasms[mh] AND humans[mh]`, retmax 25, 333 total hits |
| `efetch_metformin_crc_25.xml` | 25 ids | efetch of exactly the 25 ids above: 20 with abstracts, 5 without (`28506970 30385499 32384400 28506966 21949227`) |

Not covered because no real record could be found: an article with a reference list but no DOI of its own. That
case is a small hand-built XML in `tests/unit/test_pubmed_parser.py`, labelled as such.

To re-record, rerun the same requests; expect `esearch_metformin_crc.json` and the 25-paper batch to drift as
PubMed adds papers, and update the expected values in the tests by hand when they do.
